messages:
Sophie CSM: Quick digest from onboarding / renewal conversations this week — 6 recurring pain points that stuck out. Posting raw notes so PM/ENG can triage. TL;DR: embeddings mismatch on similar queries, per-route cost isn't visible to customers, exports (CSV) missing columns, tokenization trimming in long prompts, A/B rollout flips mid-session, docs on permissioning unclear. Details below.

Maya CS Ops: thanks — can you paste the exact repro steps or a sample payload?

Sophie CSM: yes, here's a redacted payload we got from AcmeRetail:
```json
{"prompt":"Summarize order history","route":"orders/v2","embedding_model":"xlarge-emb-1","input_tokens":2150}
```
Observation: embeddings drift when company_token present vs absent — similarity drops >0.12 across several queries.

Ashley (PM): marking as product triage candidate. Suggest scoring by customer impact + occurrence frequency. Can we get counts per account? @Maya

Maya CS Ops: I've pulled counts — 12 accounts reported embeddings drift, 8 asked about exports, 4 flagged per-route cost confusion. Uploading consolidated sheet: https://drive.redwood.example/sheets/triage (private) :link: 

Jordan (Eng): For embeddings drift, can you attach a small sample pair (original+query+expected similarity)? I'll run a local eval on the same model/quantization. Also which runtime variant were they on (quantized vs fp16)?

Sophie CSM: pasted a minimal sample inline for Jordan — original vs query + similarity numbers below. Also note most affected accounts are on dedicated pools with model variant `xlarge-emb-1-q8`.

Maya CS Ops: Proposal: quick internal triage tomorrow 30m, output: (1) decide rollback/canary, (2) owners for fixes, (3) prioritized bug tickets with impact estimates. Are we good for 11:00 PST?

Ashley (PM): 11:00 PST works. I'll bring an impact matrix and propose an initial priority ordering (impact x complexity). Jordan, can you take embeddings as owner for investigation?

Jordan (Eng): I'll own the embeddings investigation and bring repro + perf delta. If we see model-variant covariance, we can suggest a temporary routing rule to fallback to fp16 for affected customers. :thumbsup:

signal-bot: New triage meeting created — calendar invite sent to participants. Meeting ID 123-456.

Sophie CSM: thanks team — main ask before meeting: Maya to paste the per-account counts + 2 representative example pairs, Jordan to confirm test harness command, Ashley to prepare the impact template. Goal: prioritized 2-week plan before next renewals batch. :rocket:
